2610.09937.title: Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift
2610.09937.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.
2610.09937.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧以多種形式支持建築運營，每種形式都有其自身的障礙。專家規則必須為每個系統進行調整，監督模型需要標記數據，而建築物很少記錄這些數據，語言模型則返回需要人類檢查的自由文本，因為它們所聲明的信心不可靠。一種較新的預訓練模型，這裡稱為決策模型，為每個允許的答案返回一個概率，因此一個模型可以在不進行訓練的情況下服務於多個決策。本研究回答了有關供暖、通風和空調系統故障診斷的三個未解問題：這樣的模型可以做出哪些決策、它需要什麼輸入，以及當條件改變時其概率是否仍然有效。在來自四個公共數據集的128個故障日中，故障根據其診斷所需的推理進行分級，數據以原始形式、物理特徵或Brick拓撲提供。決策模型Jev、開放語言模型和一個監督模型面對九個測試，這些測試改變了季節、控制配置或建築。在給定物理特徵的情況下，Jev和較大的開放模型診斷了由一個特徵所攜帶的證據的故障，但未能診斷需要操作上下文的故障。在變更下，它們保持了準確性和校準，而監督模型則損失了0.33的宏觀F1，但在一棟建築內仍然領先或持平。它們的概率仍然需要修正，且檢測效果較弱。該研究映射了決策模型可以診斷的故障及其所需的輸入，並支持一種工作分工，其中代碼計算物理學，而模型為操作員排名候選故障。
